label: Royal-Asscher-like facet design, disappointing light return
commentary: An early James Allen example that the buyer called a 'Royal Asscher clone?' (#1) because of its apparent facet arrangement and a grey/quiet centre. Karl_K agreed the facet architecture resembled a Royal Asscher but considered its light performance substantially below better examples (#12); lovedogs also had concerns about its centre (#13). An appealing facet blueprint is not sufficient evidence of good optical performance. This early sample is NOT presumed identical to the later RA-like candidate called 'clone #2' in post #22; its original viewer was already unavailable in the source research.
